_about: Build 2026-11-10a (commit c716330), the last package of the old, lost packager. This file makes the tools here rebuild it byte for byte: the folder's 817 files and both zips (md5 9f9bd48dc638748b3ef637cdb26a2e74 and 8ece91bf4617ee0bd214c78b22d0d67c). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_previous: The package the asset base comes from and the verifier compares with. The 2026-11-09a package went with the old container, so this build is checked against its own package: nothing changes.

esp._edids: This build's two new records (000BF5, 000BF6), the three it changed and 2026-11-09a's gentle water loop.

_pex_header: What the old packager's compile left in the twelve .pex headers: its clock and its mktemp folder. A new build leaves this key out.
_zip: The old packager stored each file's own modification time; these are the original zip's. A new build leaves this key out (every member then carries the commit's time).
